scope: Deterministic Section 5.4 storage-planning sidecar. This is an analytical no-escape raw-PVTK payload estimate only. It is not runtime evidence, a storage reservation, campaign authorization, or qualification evidence.

assumptions.particle_retention: No particle escape. All shock-injected particles with birth_time >= 45 remain retained.
assumptions.cadence: Retain PVTK at t=0 and every output4/dt=100 through time/tlim=1200.
assumptions.quantization: Continuous swept-mass analytical rate. Runtime timestep-edge and carried mass-reservoir sub-particle quantization are excluded.
assumptions.payload_scope: Raw PVTK binary particle arrays only. ASCII headers, MHD bin outputs, restart files, logs, filesystem allocation, replication, and safety margin are excluded.
